text: This airline flies twice daily between the two cities.
translation: 这条航线每天在两座城市之间飞两班。
note: airline 此处指「航线」，即空中航线，不是航空公司。

text: The airline was closed by heavy fog all morning.
translation: 这条航线整个上午因大雾而关闭。
note: airline 意为「航线」。

text: That airline over the pole is rarely used in winter.
translation: 那条飞越极地的航线冬天很少使用。
note: airline 此处是「航线」，与公司无关。

text: The airline between the islands operates only on Fridays.
translation: 岛间航线只在每周五运营。
note: airline 意为「航线」。

text: Weather forced the airline to change its usual path.
translation: 天气迫使该航线改变其通常的航路。
note: airline 此处指「航线」。

text: The young boxer moved first and anticipated his rival's punch.
translation: 年轻拳手先动，预判了对手的出拳。
note: 此处 anticipate 是「先发制人、抢先行动」，不是「预料」。

text: Our team will anticipate the storm by leaving early today.
translation: 我们队打算先发制人，趁今天早点撤离以应对风暴。
note: anticipate 此处指抢先行动以占先机。

text: He anticipated the attack and blocked it in time.
translation: 他预判出攻击并及时挡住。
note: anticipate 意为先一步察觉并应对，抢先化解。

text: The company anticipated its rivals by opening a new shop first.
translation: 公司先发制人，抢先开了新店。
note: anticipate 是抢先做，占据先机。

text: Quick to anticipate, she changed the plan before anyone noticed.
translation: 她反应快、先发制人，在没人察觉前就改了计划。
note: anticipate 此处指抢先一步采取行动。

text: Her apartment has two rooms and a tiny balcony.
translation: 她的公寓有两个房间和一个小阳台。
note: apartment 指供人居住的房间单元。

text: The apartment upstairs is rented to a young couple.
translation: 楼上那套公寓租给了一对年轻夫妇。
note: apartment 是一套独立的居住单元。

text: We painted the apartment before moving in last spring.
translation: 去年春天搬家前我们把公寓粉刷了一遍。
note: apartment 意为「公寓、一套房」。

text: His apartment looks over the busy market square.
translation: 他的公寓俯瞰热闹的市场广场。
note: apartment 是一套带独立门户的住宅。

text: Apartment prices in this district rose again last year.
translation: 这个区的公寓价格去年又涨了。
note: apartment 意为「公寓住宅单元」。

text: Smoke began to arise from the burning roof above us.
translation: 浓烟开始从我们上方燃烧的屋顶冒上来。
note: arise 此处是「上升、升起」，强调由下往上。

text: A loud noise arose from the basement at midnight.
translation: 午夜时地下室传来一声巨响。
note: arise 此处意为「升起、出现（声音等）」。

text: Water vapour arises from the wet ground all morning.
translation: 水汽整个上午从湿地上升腾而起。
note: arise 意为「上升、升起」。

text: Heat arises quickly from the hot coals in the stove.
translation: 热量从炉子里的热煤中迅速升起。
note: arise 此处是「上升、散发出来」。

text: A bad smell arose from the old drain outside.
translation: 一股臭味从外面的旧下水沟冒上来。
note: arise 意为「升起、出现」。

text: Only one route is available through the mountain pass.
translation: 只有一条路线可经由山口通行。
note: available 此处是「可行的、可用的」。

text: Is Friday afternoon available for a short meeting?
translation: 周五下午有空开个短会吗？
note: available 意为「可行的、可以安排」。

text: The doctor is available for consultations on Tuesday mornings.
translation: 医生周二上午可以看诊。
note: available 意为「可应约的、可安排的」。

text: No parking is available near the old bridge.
translation: 旧桥附近没有可用的停车位。
note: available 此处意为「可提供的、可用的」。

text: The earlier train is available if you book online.
translation: 如果在线预订，可以乘更早的那班车。
note: available 意为「可获得的、可行的」。

text: The lake looked beautiful in the early morning mist.
translation: 清晨薄雾中的湖看起来很美。
note: beautiful 形容景色美好。

text: She wore a beautiful dress to the evening party.
translation: 她穿着一条漂亮的裙子去参加晚会。
note: beautiful 形容外表美丽动人。

text: The garden is beautiful, though few people visit it.
translation: 这个花园很美，尽管很少有人来。
note: beautiful 描述令人赏心悦目的景象。

text: The old town has beautiful stone bridges over the river.
translation: 这座古镇有美丽的石桥横跨河上。
note: beautiful 形容景色优雅动人。

text: It was a beautiful morning for a long walk outside.
translation: 那是个适合户外长距离散步的美好清晨。
note: beautiful 形容天气或时刻宜人美好。

text: His face went blank when he heard the bad news.
translation: 听到坏消息时他脸色突然僵住了。
note: blank 此处是「失色的、面无表情的」。

text: She looked at me with a blank expression and said nothing.
translation: 她面无表情地看着我，一句话也没说。
note: blank 形容表情空白、没有神色。

text: The audience sat in blank silence after the announcement.
translation: 公告之后，观众席陷入一片死寂。
note: blank 此处修饰 silence，表示空白的、呆滞的。

text: He turned blank when the question came to him.
translation: 问题问到 him 时他脸上什么表情也没有。
note: blank 是「脸上没有表情的」。

text: Her blank stare showed she had not heard a word.
translation: 她茫然的目光表明她一个字也没听见。
note: blank stare 指呆滞无神的凝视。

text: The room is bright in the morning because of the large window.
translation: 因为大窗户，房间早上很明亮。
note: bright 形容光线充足、明亮。

text: The stars look especially bright on cold winter nights.
translation: 在寒冷的冬夜，星星显得格外明亮。
note: bright 此处形容发光强度。

text: She has bright eyes that catch the light quickly.
translation: 她有一双被光一照就亮的眼睛。
note: bright 形容眼睛明亮有神。

text: A bright orange light flashed briefly over the hills.
translation: 一道明亮的橙光在山丘上闪过。
note: bright 形容光线亮。

text: The kitchen needs cleaning; the stove is far too bright.
translation: 厨房该擦了，炉灶火太亮了。
note: bright 此处指过于强烈的亮光。

text: The capital of France is a city full of museums.
translation: 法国的首都是一座充满博物馆的城市。
note: capital 此处指「首都」。

text: Parliament meets in the capital every January.
translation: 议会每年一月在首都开会。
note: capital 是国家行政中心、首都。

text: Many young people move to the capital to find work.
translation: 许多年轻人搬到首都去找工作。
note: capital 强调其政治中心地位。

text: The old capital lost its importance after the war.
translation: 战后这座旧首都失去了它的重要地位。
note: capital 指曾作为首都的城市。

text: Their flight to the capital was delayed three hours today.
translation: 他们飞往首都的航班今天延误了三小时。
note: capital 是一国的政治中心。

text: Write your name in capital letters at the top of the form.
translation: 把你的名字用大写字母写在表格顶端。
note: capital 此处指「大写字母」。

text: The sign was written in block capital letters for everyone to read.
translation: 招牌用大写字母书写，让每个人都能看清。
note: capital 此处意为「大写字母」。

text: He wrote PARIS in big capital letters on the poster.
translation: 他在海报上用大写字母写下 PARIS。
note: capital 此处指「大写的」。

text: Please print your surname in capitals on the entrance card.
translation: 请把你的姓用大写字母印在入场卡上。
note: capital 此处意为「大写字母」。

text: The letter 'R' looks the same in capital and small form here.
translation: 这里的字母 R 在大写和小写形式下看起来一样。
note: capital 此处指「大写」。

text: She cares a lot about her students and their families.
translation: 她非常关心她的学生和他们的家庭。
note: care 此处是「关心、在意」。

text: He did not care whether they approved of the plan.
translation: 他并不在意他们是否赞成这个计划。
note: care 此处意为「在乎、计较」。

text: Drivers must care for the safety of everyone on board.
translation: 驾驶员必须关心车上每个人的安全。
note: care 意为「关心、重视」。

text: I do not care if the meeting starts ten minutes late.
translation: 会议晚十分钟开始我并不在意。
note: care 此处是「在乎、介意」。

text: She cares deeply about protecting the small forest nearby.
translation: 她深深在意保护附近那片小森林。
note: care 意为「关心、爱护」。

text: The magazine caters to young readers who like design.
translation: 这本杂志迎合喜欢设计的年轻读者。
note: cater 意为「迎合、投其所好」。

text: The hotel caters mainly to business travelers each autumn.
translation: 这家酒店主要迎合秋季出差的商务旅客。
note: cater 意为「满足某种人或某事的需要」。

text: This shop caters to people who love old books.
translation: 这家店迎合喜爱旧书的人。
note: cater 意为「迎合、服务于某群体」。

text: The program caters to both children and parents on weekends.
translation: 这个节目周末同时迎合孩子和家长。
note: cater 意为「迎合不同受众」。

text: She caters to her guests with homemade bread and soup.
translation: 她用自制面包和汤来招待客人。
note: cater 意为「迎合、提供服务」。

text: He cleaned the entire kitchen completely before dinner.
translation: 他在晚饭前把整个厨房彻底清洗干净。
note: complete 此处是副词「完全地、彻底地」。

text: She completely forgot the meeting after the phone call.
translation: 那个电话之后她完全忘了开会的事。
note: complete 意为「完全地」，修饰动词。

text: The road was completely blocked by fallen rocks overnight.
translation: 这条路整个晚上被落石完全堵住。
note: complete 此处是副词「完全、彻底」。

text: We completely rebuilt the wall after the earthquake.
translation: 地震之后我们完全重建了墙。
note: complete 此处意为「完全地」。

text: The letter was completely destroyed by the leaking pipe.
translation: 这封信被漏水的水管彻底毁掉了。
note: complete 此处是副词「完全地」。

text: Her health is my main concern after the long surgery.
translation: 长时间手术后，她的健康是我最担心的事。
note: concern 此处作名词，意为「关心、忧虑」。

text: There is growing public concern about the rising prices.
translation: 公众对物价上涨日益关注。
note: concern 意为「关注、忧虑」。

text: His comment caused concern among the local parents.
translation: 他的评论引起了当地家长的关注。
note: concern 意为「关切」。

text: We share a common concern for the future of the town.
translation: 我们对镇子的未来有共同的忧虑。
note: concern 此处是名词「忧虑、关切」。

text: Safety of the workers is the company's main concern.
translation: 员工安全是公司最关心的事。
note: concern 意为「关心的事项」。

text: The war brought crime, violence, and fear to every street.
translation: 战争把犯罪、暴力和恐惧带到了每一条街。
note: criminal 此处作名词，意为「犯罪活动」这一现象。

text: Too much criminal activity keeps tourists away from the port.
translation: 太多犯罪活动使游客远离这个港口。
note: criminal 修饰 activity，意为「犯罪的」。

text: They moved away because of the criminal element in town.
translation: 他们搬走了，因为镇上有犯罪分子。
note: criminal 此处指「犯罪活动/犯罪分子」。

text: The film shows how criminal life destroys small towns.
translation: 这部电影展现犯罪活动如何摧毁小镇。
note: criminal 此处作名词，意为「犯罪（现象）」。

text: Local leaders fought to reduce criminal activity near schools.
translation: 当地领导人努力减少学校附近的犯罪活动。
note: criminal 意为「犯罪的」，此处指犯罪活动整体。

text: The current of public opinion turned against the plan.
translation: 舆论的潮流转而反对这项计划。
note: current 此处是名词「趋势、倾向」。

text: There is a strong current of thought against this theory.
translation: 有强大的思潮反对这个理论。
note: current 意为「思潮、趋势」。

text: A current of doubt ran through the whole class.
translation: 一股怀疑的情绪流遍了全班。
note: current 此处是名词「倾向、暗流」。

text: The current of protest spread quickly through the country.
translation: 抗议的浪潮迅速传遍全国。
note: current 意为「浪潮、趋势」。

text: His opinion followed the current of the times.
translation: 他的观点追随着时代的潮流。
note: current 此处是名词「潮流、趋势」。

text: The farmer works from daily dawn to dark in the field.
translation: 农民从每日的破晓一直劳作到天黑。
note: daily 此处是名词，指「破晓、清晨」。

text: Cock crowing at daily woke the whole village early.
translation: 破晓时的鸡叫早早唤醒了全村。
note: daily 作为名词意为「黎明、破晓时分」。

text: Few buses run on the road at daily.
translation: 破晓时分，这条路上很少有公交车在跑。
note: daily 作名词指一天中最早的时候。

text: They left before daily to catch the first ferry.
translation: 他们赶在破晓前出发去赶第一班渡轮。
note: daily 此处是名词「破晓」。

text: The night watch ended just as daily began to break.
translation: 守夜结束的时候破晓正好开始。
note: daily 意为「黎明、破晓」。

text: The shop opens at the daily of the working year.
translation: 这家店在工作年的年初开始营业。
note: daily 此处是名词「开始、开端」。

text: From the daily of his career he never gave up.
translation: 从他职业生涯的开始起，他就从未放弃。
note: daily 意为「开端、起始」。

text: It is a good daily to begin such a long task.
translation: 开始这样一项长期任务，开个好头很重要。
note: daily 此处是名词「开始、开端」。

text: The daily of the festival was marked by loud drums.
translation: 节日的开始以喧闹的鼓声为标志。
note: daily 意为「开端、开始」。

text: Wrong choices at the daily shaped his whole life.
translation: 在开头做出的错误选择决定了他的一生。
note: daily 此处是名词「开始、起始」。

text: Our views differ sharply on how to solve the problem.
translation: 我们在如何解决这个问题上看法差别很大。
note: differ 此处意为「相异、不同」，是 vi.。

text: The results differ from what the researchers had expected.
translation: 结果与研究人员预期的不同。
note: differ 意为「与……不同」。

text: Prices in the two cities differ by nearly ten dollars.
translation: 两个城市的价格相差近十美元。
note: differ 意为「有差异」，是 vi.。

text: Temperatures here differ greatly from those in the north.
translation: 这里的气温与北方相差很大。
note: differ 是不及物动词，意为「相异」。

text: Their opinions differ, yet they remain close friends.
translation: 他们观点不同，却仍是好朋友。
note: differ 此处为 vi.，意为「不同」。

text: The manager is a dynamic leader who inspires the team.
translation: 这位经理是一位鼓舞团队的活力型领导者。
note: dynamic 此处作名词，指「动力、活力」。

text: She brought new dynamic to the failing department.
translation: 她为这个陷入困境的部门带来了新的动力。
note: dynamic 作名词意为「活力、动力」。

text: The new player added real dynamic to the second half.
translation: 那位新球员为下半场增添了真正的活力。
note: dynamic 是名词，指推动力。

text: Lack of dynamic in the economy worries economists.
translation: 经济缺乏活力让经济学家担忧。
note: dynamic 作名词，意为「动力、能动性」。

text: His speech lacked the dynamic needed to move voters.
translation: 他的演讲缺乏打动选民的活力。
note: dynamic 此处是名词「动力、气势」。

text: The language model is highly dynamic and learns quickly.
translation: 这个语言模型非常动态，学习很快。
note: dynamic 此处是形容词「动态的、变化的」。

text: Prices are dynamic and change with every supply shock.
translation: 价格是动态的，会随每一次供应冲击而变化。
note: dynamic 形容「不断变化的、动态的」。

text: The system is dynamic, adjusting as the situation changes.
translation: 这个系统是动态的，会随情况变化而调整。
note: dynamic 此处意为「动态的、可变的」。

text: Her dynamic acting kept the audience fully awake.
translation: 她充满活力的表演让观众全程保持清醒。
note: dynamic 作形容词意为「有活力的、动态的」。

text: A dynamic economy needs flexible rules and quick change.
translation: 充满活力的经济需要灵活的规则和快速的变化。
note: dynamic 此处形容经济是有活力的、动态发展的。

text: He eats three meals a day at the family table.
translation: 他每天在家庭餐桌上吃三顿饭。
note: eat 此处是及物动词，后接食物。

text: The child refuses to eat vegetables of any kind.
translation: 这孩子拒绝吃任何蔬菜。
note: eat 意为「吃（某种食物）」。

text: We eat fish twice a week in this household.
translation: 我们家一周吃两次鱼。
note: eat 此处是 vt.「吃、食用」。

text: Nobody in our family eats red meat these days.
translation: 我们家这几天没人吃红肉。
note: eat 此处是及物动词「食用」。

text: He ate the whole plate of noodles by himself.
translation: 他自己把一整盘面条吃光了。
note: eat 意为「吃（完）」。

text: The book explains the theory in very elementary terms.
translation: 这本书用非常简单的术语解释了这个理论。
note: elementary 此处意为「简单的、基础的」。

text: Even elementary math should be taught with real examples.
translation: 即便是简单的数学也应该用真实的例子来教。
note: elementary 此处形容「简单的」。

text: He has only an elementary knowledge of computer repair.
translation: 他对电脑维修只有一点基础了解。
note: elementary 此处意为「初步的、简单的」。

text: The course assumes no more than elementary physics background.
translation: 这门课假定学生只有基础物理知识。
note: elementary 此处意为「基础的、初步的」。

text: She gave me some elementary advice about safe driving.
translation: 她给了我一些关于安全驾驶的简单建议。
note: elementary 此处是形容词「简单的」。

text: The coach enforced daily training by arriving at dawn.
translation: 教练以每天清晨到场的方式强制训练。
note: enforce 此处是「强迫（某人做某事）」。

text: His parents enforced an early bedtime every single night.
translation: 他父母每晚都强迫他早睡。
note: enforce 意为「强逼、强迫」。

text: The teacher enforced silence by standing near the door.
translation: 老师站在门边以强迫大家安静。
note: enforce 此处是 vt.「强迫」。

text: The manager enforced honesty by signing every report himself.
translation: 经理亲自签署每份报告，以强求诚实。
note: enforce 意为「强使、坚持要求」。

text: The law enforced strict limits on working hours.
translation: 法律强制作业时间受到严格限制。
note: enforce 此处意为「强制实施」。

text: The shop sells everyday tools at very low prices.
translation: 这家店以很低的价格出售日常工具。
note: everyday 此处意为「日常使用的、日常的」。

text: These shoes are cheap but good for everyday use.
translation: 这双鞋便宜，但日常穿着很合适。
note: everyday 意为「日常的、平常的」。

text: We keep a small notebook for everyday notes.
translation: 我们有一个小本子记日常笔记。
note: everyday 此处是形容词「日常的」。

text: Her everyday dress was always simple and clean.
translation: 她平日的衣着总是简单干净的。
note: everyday 意为「平日的、日常的」。

text: The market sells fruit that is perfect for everyday cooking.
translation: 市场卖的水果非常适合日常烹饪。
note: everyday 此处意为「日常的」。

text: The price does not include tax or service charges.
translation: 这个价格不含税，也不含服务费。
note: exclude 意为「不包括、把……排除在外」。

text: We must exclude weekends from the working schedule.
translation: 我们必须把周末从工作安排中排除。
note: exclude 意为「排除」。

text: The rules exclude anyone under eighteen from entry.
translation: 规定把十八岁以下者排除在入场之外。
note: exclude 意为「不让进入、排除」。

text: Careful wide research excludes many false assumptions.
translation: 谨慎的研究排除了许多错误的假设。
note: exclude 意为「排除、剔除」。

text: The report excludes students who missed the test.
translation: 这份报告把缺考的学生排除在外。
note: exclude 意为「把……排除在外」。

text: The country exports coffee to buyers across Europe.
translation: 该国向欧洲各地的买家出口咖啡。
note: export 此处是动词「输出、出口」。

text: This software lets you export photos to a computer.
translation: 这个软件让你能把照片导出到电脑。
note: export 此处意为「输出、导出（数据）」。

text: Small factories export their goods only to nearby countries.
translation: 小工厂只把货物出口到邻近国家。
note: export 意为「输出、出口到国外」。

text: You can export the list as a text file easily.
translation: 你可以轻松把列表导出为文本文件。
note: export 此处是动词「导出（数据）」。

text: The city exports clean energy technology to other regions.
translation: 该市向其他地区输出清洁能源技术。
note: export 意为「输出、出口」。

text: It was fatal for the whole plan that he resigned early.
translation: 他早早辞职，这对整个计划是致命的。
note: fatal 此处意为「决定命运的、命定的」。

text: The same mistake proved fatal to his career forever.
translation: 同样的错误给他的职业生涯带来致命影响。
note: fatal 此处意为「致命的、带来毁灭的」。

text: Their fatal delay in signing cost them the contract.
translation: 签约的致命延误让他们丢掉了合同。
note: fatal 意为「决定性的、极其严重的」。

text: A fatal wound to the engine stopped the plane.
translation: 发动机上致命的损伤让飞机停了下来。
note: fatal 此处意为「致命的」。

text: Ignoring that warning was fatal for the whole crew.
translation: 无视那个警告对全体机组人员是致命的。
note: fatal 此处意为「致命后果的」。

text: It is ten miles to the lighthouse, so we foot it.
translation: 到灯塔有十英里，所以我们步行去。
note: foot 此处是动词「步行、走路」。

text: We footed to the station instead of taking a taxi.
translation: 我们步行去车站，没有打车。
note: foot 意为「走、步行」。

text: The old horse refused to foot the long mountain path.
translation: 那匹老马不肯走这条漫长的山路。
note: foot 此处是 v.「行走」。

text: He footed home alone through the heavy snow.
translation: 他独自冒雪走回了家。
note: foot 意为「步行、走」。

text: They footed all the way to save the taxi fare.
translation: 他们一路步行，以省下打车费。
note: foot 此处是动词「走路」。

text: The charity raised funds for children in poor villages.
translation: 这个慈善机构为贫困村庄的孩子们筹集了资金。
note: fund 此处作名词，意为「资金、款项」。

text: The project was delayed because of a shortage of funds.
translation: 该项目因资金短缺而延期。
note: fund 此处是名词「资金」。

text: She set up a fund to support young musicians.
translation: 她设立了一个支持年轻音乐家的基金。
note: fund 作名词意为「基金、专款」。

text: The university relies on government funds for basic research.
translation: 这所大学依靠政府资金进行基础研究。
note: fund 此处指提供支持的款项。

text: His plan needs more funds than we currently have.
translation: 他的计划需要比我们现有更多的资金。
note: fund 此处作名词「资金」。

text: She spends every weekend doing garden work outside.
translation: 她每个周末都在户外做园艺活。
note: garden 此处是名词「园艺、园艺业」，指劳作。

text: Garden work keeps him busy every Saturday morning.
translation: 园艺劳作让他每周六上午都很忙。
note: garden 作名词指「园艺劳动」。

text: He learned garden skills from his grandmother in the village.
translation: 他在村里从祖母那里学到了园艺技能。
note: garden 此处是名词，意为「园艺」。

text: The course covers garden design and planting methods.
translation: 这门课涵盖园艺设计和种植方法。
note: garden 此处作名词「园艺、园艺业」。

text: Modern garden work now uses electric tools instead of hand tools.
translation: 现代园艺劳作现在使用电动工具而非手工工具。
note: garden 此处指「园艺（工作）」。

text: There was hardly any food left in the empty pantry.
translation: 空荡荡的厨房里几乎没剩下什么食物。
note: hardly 此处意为「几乎不、几乎」，是 s2 义。

text: She can hardly walk after the ankle surgery yesterday.
translation: 昨天脚踝手术后她几乎走不了路。
note: hardly 此处意为「几乎不能」。

text: Hardly a day passed without him calling the office.
translation: 几乎没有一天他不给办公室打电话。
note: hardly 此处意为「几乎」。

text: The old bridge could hardly hold the weight of trucks.
translation: 这座旧桥几乎承受不住卡车的重量。
note: hardly 此处是副词「几乎不」。

text: He hardly noticed the change in her tone that day.
translation: 那天他几乎没有注意到她语气的变化。
note: hardly 此处意为「几乎没有」。

text: He did everything in a hurry and forgot his keys.
translation: 他做什么事都急急忙忙，还忘了钥匙。
note: hurry 此处是形容词「匆忙的、草率的」，形容状态。

text: The morning was a hurry to catch the early bus.
translation: 那个早晨是匆忙赶早班车的。
note: hurry 此处意为「匆忙的状态」。

text: Her reply showed a hurry that was not quite polite.
translation: 她的回复显出一种不太礼貌的匆忙。
note: hurry 此处是形容词「匆忙的」。

text: A hurried meal is often a cold sandwich standing up.
translation: 匆忙的一餐常常是站着吃的冷三明治。
note: hurry 此处指「匆忙的」状态。

text: The whole morning was a blur of hurry and worry.
translation: 整个上午都是一片匆忙和担忧的模糊。
note: hurry 此处意为「匆忙」。

text: Inflation has made the cost of living rise quickly.
translation: 通货膨胀使生活成本迅速上升。
note: inflation 此处是名词，意为「通货膨胀」。

text: The government raised interest rates to control inflation.
translation: 政府提高利率以控制通货膨胀。
note: inflation 此处是「通货膨胀、物价上涨」。

text: High inflation makes saving money harder for families.
translation: 高通货膨胀让家庭储蓄变得更难。
note: inflation 此处指「通胀、物价上涨」。

text: Wages could not keep up with the sharp inflation last year.
translation: 去年工资跟不上急剧的通货膨胀。
note: inflation 此处是名词「通货膨胀」。

text: Slow inflation is less harmful to small businesses than high.
translation: 温和的通货膨胀对小企业的伤害小于高通胀。
note: inflation 此处意为「通货膨胀」。

text: The medicine brought instant relief to her headache.
translation: 这药立刻缓解了她的头痛。
note: instant 此处是副词「立刻、瞬间」。

text: He felt instant shame when he saw the result.
translation: 看到结果时他立刻感到羞愧。
note: instant 此处是副词，意为「立即」。

text: The wound caused instant pain after the fall.
translation: 摔倒后伤口立刻疼痛起来。
note: instant 此处是副词「立刻」。

text: There was instant silence after the principal spoke.
translation: 校长说完后立刻一片安静。
note: instant 此处是副词「马上、当场」。

text: The treatment showed instant results within an hour.
translation: 这个治疗一小时内就显示出立即的效果。
note: instant 此处是副词「立刻」。

text: Marriage is an important social institution in most cultures.
translation: 婚姻在大多数文化中是重要的社会制度。
note: institution 此处指「制度、机构（社会意义）」。

text: Universities are ancient institutions that survive many reforms.
translation: 大学是历经多次改革仍延续的古老制度。
note: institution 此处是「制度」。

text: The rule about copyright is a legal institution, not a custom.
translation: 关于版权的规定是一种法律制度，而非习俗。
note: institution 此处指「制度、机构」。

text: Trust is a basic institution in every working relationship.
translation: 信任是每一种工作关系中的基本制度。
note: institution 此处意为「制度」。

text: He studied how that institution protects the rights of children.
translation: 他研究那个机构如何保护儿童权利。
note: institution 此处指「机构、组织」。

text: The storm lasted for three long days and nights.
translation: 暴风雨持续了整整三天三夜。
note: last 此处是动词「持续」。

text: The meeting lasted longer than anyone had expected.
translation: 会议持续的时间比任何人预想的都长。
note: last 意为「持续」。

text: Their friendship has lasted for more than forty years.
translation: 他们的友谊持续了四十多年。
note: last 意为「持续、延续」。

text: The fire lasted until the firemen finally arrived.
translation: 大火一直烧到消防员赶到才结束。
note: last 此处是 vi.，意为「持续」。

text: His illness lasted through the whole cold winter.
translation: 他的病持续了整个寒冷的冬天。
note: last 此处意为「持续」。

text: She likes to lay on the grass and read novels.
translation: 她喜欢躺在草地上读小说。
note: lay 此处是「躺、卧」，注意与 lie（躺）形式区分。

text: The cat lays beside the warm fire every afternoon.
translation: 那只猫每天下午都躺在暖炉旁。
note: lay 此处意为「躺、卧」。

text: He laid in the shade and drank cold water all day.
translation: 他整天躺在阴凉处喝凉水。
note: lay 此处是「躺、躺卧」。

text: The injured deer lay still under the tall pines.
translation: 受伤的鹿一动不动地躺在高高的松树下。
note: lay 此处意为「躺」。

text: Birds lay in the reeds until the storm passed.
translation: 鸟儿在芦苇丛中躺卧，直到风暴过去。
note: lay 此处作动词「躺、栖卧」。

text: The old village lies quietly between two green hills.
translation: 这座古老的村庄静静地卧在两座青山之间。
note: lay 此处是动词「位于、处在（某处）」。

text: The temple lies far from the busy city center.
translation: 这座寺庙远离繁忙的市中心。
note: lay 意为「位于」。

text: Our school lies just beside the small park.
translation: 我们学校就在小公园旁边。
note: lay 此处是 vi.，意为「位于」。

text: The old bridge now lies in ruins after the war.
translation: 战争之后，这座旧桥如今已成废墟。
note: lay 此处意为「处于（某种状态）、位于」。

text: The fishing port lies on the eastern edge of the lake.
translation: 这个渔港位于湖的东岸边缘。
note: lay 意为「位于、坐落在」。

text: He never admitted he lay about his salary last year.
translation: 他从不承认去年谎报了工资。
note: lay 此处是动词「说谎」，是 lie 的过去式。

text: The witness lay in court about what he had seen.
translation: 证人在法庭上就他看到的事撒谎。
note: lay 此处意为「说谎」。

text: She lay to the teacher about being late again.
translation: 她向老师撒谎说自己又迟到了。
note: lay 此处是「说谎」之意。

text: Suspecting the boy, the coach lay about his practice time.
translation: 教练怀疑那个男孩，谎报了他的训练时间。
note: lay 意为「说谎、说假话」。

text: He lay in the interview about his work experience.
translation: 他在面试中对自己的工作经验撒谎。
note: lay 此处意为「说谎」。

text: His parents are liberal and let him choose freely.
translation: 他的父母很开明，让他自由选择。
note: liberal 此处意为「开明的、不拘束的」。

text: The judge gave a liberal interpretation of the old rule.
translation: 法官对那条旧规则作了宽松的解释。
note: liberal 意为「开明的、宽大的」。

text: They grew liberal in their views after years abroad.
translation: 在国外多年后，他们的观点变得开明。
note: liberal 此处意为「开明的、宽容的」。

text: The professor was liberal with students who disagreed.
translation: 那位教授对持不同意见的学生很宽容。
note: liberal 意为「宽大的、不苛刻的」。

text: The magazine stays liberal in its support of free speech.
translation: 这本杂志在支持言论自由方面一向开明。
note: liberal 此处意为「开明的、自由的」。

text: The train is literally full from morning to night.
translation: 这趟火车从早到晚几乎挤满了人。
note: literally 此处意为「几乎、简直」，是口语义。

text: He literally ran out of time before the exam.
translation: 考试之前他几乎耗尽了时间。
note: literally 意为「几乎、差不多」。

text: The hall was literally empty by nine o'clock.
translation: 到九点时，大厅几乎已经空了。
note: literally 此处意为「简直、几乎」。

text: Our team literally could not hear a single word.
translation: 我们队几乎一个字也听不清。
note: literally 意为「几乎、简直」。

text: She literally has no idea what he meant yesterday.
translation: 她几乎完全不明白他昨天是什么意思。
note: literally 此处意为「几乎、完全」。

text: The rain made the road too slippery to drive safely.
translation: 大雨使路面太滑，无法安全驾驶。
note: make 此处是使役动词「使得、致使」。

text: Her sudden exit made everyone fall silent at once.
translation: 她的突然离开使所有人一下子都沉默了。
note: make 意为「使得、让」。

text: The teacher made us rewrite the essay three times.
translation: 老师让我们把那篇文章重写了三遍。
note: make 此处是使役用法「让某人做某事」。

text: The heavy snow made the train two hours late.
translation: 大雪使火车晚点了两个小时。
note: make 意为「致使、导致」。

text: The new rules made it illegal to park on that street.
translation: 新规使在那条街上停车变得非法。
note: make 此处是「使得、致使」。

text: He greeted us in a warm and courteous manner.
translation: 他以热情而有礼貌的方式向我们问候。
note: manner 此处是名词，意为「礼貌、举止」。

text: She spoke in a calm manner even under pressure.
translation: 即使在压力下她说话的方式也很冷静。
note: manner 此处指「举止、方式」。

text: He had the good manners to thank his host warmly.
translation: 他有良好的礼貌，热情地感谢了主人。
note: manner 此处意为「礼仪、礼貌」。

text: Her nervous manner gave away her lack of confidence.
translation: 她紧张的举止暴露了她的不自信。
note: manner 意为「举止、方式」。

text: I admired the respectful manner in which she spoke.
translation: 我钦佩她说话时那种恭敬的举止。
note: manner 此处是名词「举止、礼貌」。

text: Meanwhile, the price of grain continued to climb sharply.
translation: 与此同时，粮价继续大幅攀升。
note: meanwhile 是副词「与此同时」，表时间并列。

text: Meanwhile, she finished her report before the deadline passed.
translation: 与此同时，她在截止日期前完成了报告。
note: meanwhile 意为「同时、与此同时」。

text: Meanwhile the storm rolled in from the open sea.
translation: 与此同时，暴风雨从开阔的海面袭来。
note: meanwhile 意为「与此同时」。

text: Meanwhile, the students discussed the exam in the hallway.
translation: 与此同时，学生们在走廊里讨论考试。
note: meanwhile 此处是副词表同时发生。

text: Meanwhile his health slowly improved week by week.
translation: 与此同时，他的健康逐周慢慢好转。
note: meanwhile 意为「同时、与此同时」。

text: The moon rose slowly above the quiet pine trees.
translation: 月亮慢慢升到安静的松树之上。
note: moon 此处是名词，指月亮本身。

text: The full moon lit the whole garden with silver light.
translation: 满月用银色光芒照亮了整个花园。
note: moon 是名词，指月亮。

text: Astronomers mapped the surface of the moon in detail.
translation: 天文学家详细绘制了月球的表面。
note: moon 此处指地球的天然卫星「月球」。

text: She stared at the moon through her bedroom window.
translation: 她透过卧室的窗户凝视着月亮。
note: moon 是名词，指月亮。

text: Many poems describe a lover looking up at the moon.
translation: 许多诗篇描写恋人仰望月亮。
note: moon 此处指月亮（诗情意象）。

text: The library stands quite near the main train station.
translation: 图书馆离主火车站相当近。
note: near 此处是形容词「近的、距离小的」。

text: We chose a restaurant near the hotel for dinner.
translation: 我们选了 hotels 附近的一家餐厅吃晚饭。
note: near 意为「近的、在附近的」。

text: Her flat is near enough to walk to work daily.
translation: 她的公寓离得很近，可以每天步行上班。
note: near 此处表示「距离小的」。

text: The exam hall sits near the college main gate.
translation: 考场坐落在学院大门附近。
note: near 意为「附近的、邻近的」。

text: He parked his car near the front entrance of the store.
translation: 他把车停在商店正门附近。
note: near 此处是形容词「近的」。

text: We grew up near each other in the same small town.
translation: 我们在同一个小镇一起长大，关系很亲近。
note: near 此处是形容词「亲近的、关系密切的」。

text: The two sisters are near to each other after all these years.
translation: 过了这么多年，两姐妹依然亲近。
note: near 意为「亲近的、亲密的」。

text: The manager keeps everyone near and works closely with the team.
translation: 经理和大家很亲近，和团队紧密合作。
note: near 此处表示「亲近的」。

text: Though they argue often, they remain very near.
translation: 虽然他们经常争吵，但依然非常亲近。
note: near 意为「关系亲近的」。

text: He is near to his children and calls them daily.
translation: 他和子女关系亲近，每天都给他们打电话。
note: near 此处表示「亲近的」。

text: No, I do not think that answer is correct at all.
translation: 不，我不认为那个答案是正确的。
note: no 此处是否定副词，意为「不」。

text: There is no doubt that the plan needs more work.
translation: 毫无疑问这个计划还需要更多工作。
note: no 此处意为「没有、不」。

text: He gave no answer to my question about the delay.
translation: 关于延误的问题，他没有给出任何回答。
note: no 此处作否定词「没有」。

text: No one knows exactly how the accident happened that day.
translation: 没有人确切知道那天事故是怎么发生的。
note: no 此处是否定词「没有」。

text: There is nothing to worry about, no reason at all.
translation: 没什么好担心的，完全没有理由。
note: no 此处意为「不、没有」。

text: The manual's language is so obscure that few readers follow it.
translation: 这本手册的语言晦涩难懂，很少有读者能读懂。
note: obscure 此处是形容词「晦涩难懂的」。

text: His explanation was filled with obscure terms I could not grasp.
translation: 他的解释充满了我无法理解的晦涩术语。
note: obscure 意为「晦涩难解的」。

text: The essay writes in an obscure style that hides its meaning.
translation: 这篇文章行文晦涩，隐藏了真正含义。
note: obscure 此处形容文风晦涩。

text: Technical jargon made the topic obscure to ordinary readers.
translation: 技术术语使这个话题对普通读者变得晦涩难懂。
note: obscure 意为「难懂的、晦涩的」。

text: The professor's lecture was obscure, confusing the whole class.
translation: 教授的讲座晦涩难懂，让全班都困惑。
note: obscure 此处是形容词「令人费解的」。

text: They are exact opposites on almost every political issue.
translation: 他们在几乎每个政治议题上都是完全对立的。
note: opposite 此处是名词，指「对立面、对立的人或事」。

text: The opposite wall of the room was covered with maps.
translation: 房间的对面的墙上挂满了地图。
note: opposite 此处是名词，意为「对面、对立面」。

text: Patience is the opposite of anger in her philosophy.
translation: 在她的理念里，耐心是愤怒的对立面。
note: opposite 此处是名词「对立面」。

text: He is the opposite of his cheerful older brother.
translation: 他与开朗的哥哥正好相反。
note: opposite 作名词指「相反的人或事」。

text: The two buildings stand on opposite sides of the street.
translation: 两座建筑位于街道的两侧相对。
note: opposite 此处是名词，意为「对立的另一方/面」。

text: The scan showed some organic damage in her left kidney.
translation: 扫描显示她左肾存在器质性损伤。
note: organic 此处意为「器官的」，医学名词用法。

text: The doctor suspected organic causes rather than stress.
translation: 医生怀疑是器质性原因而非精神压力。
note: organic 意为「与器官有关的」。

text: His illness was organic, not psychological, as tests showed.
translation: 检查显示他的病是器质性的，而非心理性的。
note: organic 此处意为「器官性的」。

text: The report describes organic changes in the affected tissue.
translation: 报告描述了受影响组织中的器质性改变。
note: organic 意为「器官的、器质的」。

text: Doctors found organic damage behind her failing hearing.
translation: 医生发现她听力衰退背后存在器质性损伤。
note: organic 此处指与器官结构有关的。

text: The pace of reform in that country has slowed sharply.
translation: 那个国家的改革进展已明显放缓。
note: pace 此处是名词「进展、进程」。

text: The pace of recovery surprised even the doctors.
translation: 康复的进展速度连医生都感到惊讶。
note: pace 意为「进展、进程」。

text: We must speed up the pace of our research work.
translation: 我们必须加快研究工作的进展速度。
note: pace 此处指「进展速度」。

text: His illness slowed the pace of his studies greatly.
translation: 他的病大大拖慢了他学业的进展。
note: pace 意为「进展、前进的步伐」。

text: Progress came slowly at first but the pace improved.
translation: 起初进展缓慢，但后来速度提高了。
note: pace 此处指「进展、进程」。

text: The crowd grew panic when the lights suddenly failed.
translation: 灯突然灭掉时，人群变得恐慌起来。
note: panic 此处是形容词「惊慌的、恐慌的」。

text: She looked panic and ran toward the exit door.
translation: 她神情惊慌，朝出口门跑去。
note: panic 意为「惊慌的」。

text: He was panic about losing the only copy of his thesis.
translation: 他担心丢掉论文唯一的副本，惊慌不已。
note: panic 此处作形容词「惊慌的」。

text: The panic buyers emptied every shelf within an hour.
translation: 那些恐慌的购物者一小时之内扫空了每个货架。
note: panic 修饰 buyers，意为「恐慌的」。

text: Her panic voice told us something was seriously wrong.
translation: 她惊慌的声音告诉我们出了严重问题。
note: panic 此处是形容词「惊慌的」。

text: Children learn early how to share with classmates.
translation: 孩子们很早就学会如何与同学分享。
note: participate 此处是「分享」，即参与分摊。

text: The brothers share the cost of their mother's care.
translation: 兄弟俩分摊照顾母亲的费用。
note: participate 意为「分担、分享」。

text: All team members share in the profits each winter.
translation: 所有队员每年冬天都分享利润。
note: participate 此处意为「分享（利益）」。

text: He shared in the work without asking for any pay.
translation: 他参与分担这项工作，却没有要求任何报酬。
note: participate 意为「分担、参与」。

text: She shares her lunch with the new student daily.
translation: 她每天和新来的学生分享午餐。
note: participate 此处意为「分享」。

text: Perhaps we should wait until tomorrow to decide anything.
translation: 也许我们应该等到明天再做任何决定。
note: perhaps 此处是副词「也许、可能」。

text: Perhaps the train is late because of the heavy fog.
translation: 也许火车晚点是因为大雾。
note: perhaps 意为「也许、可能」。

text: He is perhaps the best player on this whole team.
translation: 他或许是这支全队最好的球员。
note: perhaps 此处意为「大概、也许」。

text: Perhaps you could ask your teacher about this rule.
translation: 也许你可以就这条规则问问你的老师。
note: perhaps 意为「也许」。

text: It is perhaps wise to take an umbrella with you today.
translation: 今天带把伞或许是明智的。
note: perhaps 此处是副词「或许、也许」。

text: The previous owner repainted the walls a soft green.
translation: 前一位房主把墙刷成了柔和的绿色。
note: previous 此处是形容词「先前的、以前的」。

text: Her previous job was in a small design studio.
translation: 她之前的工作是在一家小型设计工作室。
note: previous 意为「先前的、从前的」。

text: We met again in the previous semester's final exam.
translation: 我们在上学期期末考试中又遇见了。
note: previous 此处表示「先前的、上一个的」。

text: No previous experience is needed for this part-time job.
translation: 这份兼职工作不需要以往的经验。
note: previous 意为「以前的、先前的」。

text: The previous chapter explained the theory in detail.
translation: 前一章详细解释了这个理论。
note: previous 意为「先前的」。

text: The city needs a radical reform of its transport system.
translation: 这座城市需要对交通系统做彻底的改革。
note: radical 此处意为「彻底的、根本的」。

text: His radical change of the plan shocked the whole team.
translation: 他对计划的彻底改变让整个团队震惊。
note: radical 意为「彻底的、全面的」。

text: The company made radical changes to its old plans.
translation: 公司对其旧计划做了彻底的修改。
note: radical 此处意为「根本的、彻底的」。

text: Only radical measures can stop the river pollution.
translation: 只有彻底的措施才能阻止这条河的污染。
note: radical 意为「彻底的」。

text: The new director made a radical clean-up of the office.
translation: 新主任对办公室做了一次彻底的大扫除。
note: radical 此处意为「彻底的、全面的」。

text: I really enjoyed the concert last night, it was wonderful.
translation: 我昨晚真的很享受那场音乐会，非常棒。
note: really 此处是副词「真的、确实」，强调真实感受。

text: She really needs more sleep before the long exam week.
translation: 在漫长的考试周之前她真的需要更多睡眠。
note: really 意为「真的、确实」。

text: He really meant what he said at the meeting yesterday.
translation: 他昨天在会上说的确实是真心话。
note: really 此处意为「确实、真的」。

text: We really had no idea the answer would be so hard.
translation: 我们真没想到答案会这么难。
note: really 意为「真的、确实」。

text: The food here is really worth trying at least once.
translation: 这里的食物真的至少值得一试。
note: really 此处是副词「真的」。

text: A reporter stood outside asking about the late decision.
translation: 一名记者站在外面询问这项迟来的决定。
note: reporter 此处是名词，指「记者、报道者」。

text: The reporter asked sharp questions about the factory fire.
translation: 记者就工厂火灾提出了尖锐的问题。
note: reporter 是「记者」。

text: She works as a reporter covering the city's local news.
translation: 她是一名报道该市本地新闻的记者。
note: reporter 此处指「记者、通讯员」。

text: The reporter refused to reveal her private sources.
translation: 记者拒绝透露她的私人消息来源。
note: reporter 意为「记者」。

text: A young reporter followed the mayor through the crowd.
translation: 一名年轻记者跟着市长穿过人群。
note: reporter 此处是「记者、新闻记者」。

text: Her face resembles her mother's in every small detail.
translation: 她的脸在每个细节上都像她的母亲。
note: resemble 此处是动词「像、类似」。

text: The two brothers resemble each other almost too closely.
translation: 这两兄弟彼此长得几乎太像了。
note: resemble 意为「与……相像」。

text: This new design resembles an ancient temple in style.
translation: 这个新设计在风格上像一座古庙。
note: resemble 意为「像、与……相似」。

text: He resembles his uncle more than his own father.
translation: 他比起自己的父亲更像他的叔叔。
note: resemble 是动词「与……相似」。

text: The quiet lake resembles a mirror lying in the hills.
translation: 这面安静的湖像山间的一面镜子。
note: resemble 此处意为「像、如同」。

text: He walked in the rain for the sake of his sick mother.
translation: 为了生病的母亲，他在雨中走着。
note: sake 此处意为「缘故、理由」。

text: She sold her bicycle for the sake of a far trip.
translation: 为了远行，她卖掉了自己的自行车。
note: sake 意为「目的、缘由」。

text: They stopped arguing for the sake of their children.
translation: 为了孩子，他们停止了争吵。
note: sake 此处意为「缘故」。

text: He stayed late for the sake of a better grade.
translation: 为了更好的成绩，他待到很晚。
note: sake 意为「目的、动机」。

text: The meal was simple, made for the sake of speed.
translation: 这顿饭很简单，是为了快。
note: sake 此处意为「目的、考虑」。

text: This office is only second rate and poorly maintained.
translation: 这间办公室只是二流水平，维护很差。
note: second 此处意为「次等的、低一等的」。

text: He plays a second violin in the school orchestra.
translation: 他在学校乐团里担任第二小提琴手。
note: second 意为「次要的、居第二的」。

text: The team finished second in the national championship game.
translation: 该队在全国锦标赛中获得第二名。
note: second 此处是「第二的」，指名次而非质量。

text: We need a second opinion before signing the contract.
translation: 签合同前我们需要第二意见。
note: second 此处意为「第二的、另一个的」。

text: The hotel is second class, but the price is low.
translation: 这家旅店是二流的，但价格便宜。
note: second 此处意为「次等的」。

text: She learned a lot about herself during those lonely years.
translation: 在那些孤独的岁月里她对自己了解了很多。
note: self 此处是名词「自我、自己」。

text: Meditation helped him find his inner self again.
translation: 冥想帮他重新找到了内在的自我。
note: self 此处是名词「自我、本我」。

text: Children must learn to care for themselves very early.
translation: 孩子必须很早就学会照顾自己。
note: self 此处是名词「自己、本人」。

text: The talk about mental health helped her accept her true self.
translation: 关于心理健康的谈话帮助她接纳真实的自我。
note: self 意为「自我、本质」。

text: Music is the way he expresses his deepest self.
translation: 音乐是他表达内心自我的方式。
note: self 此处是名词「自我」。

text: The first exam was a real snack for her.
translation: 第一次考试对她来说是件易事。
note: snack 此处作名词，指「轻便容易做的事」。

text: Answering that question was a snack after lunch.
translation: 午饭后回答那个问题是件容易的事。
note: snack 意为「容易做的事」。

text: Such a small repair is a snack for our team.
translation: 这样的小修理对我们团队来说是件易事。
note: snack 此处为名词，指容易办到的事。

text: It was a snack to fix the broken chair ourselves.
translation: 自己修好那把破椅子是件容易的事。
note: snack 意为「易事、轻便的事」。

text: For an experienced cook, this recipe is a snack.
translation: 对有经验的厨师来说，这个食谱算是易事。
note: snack 此处作名词「容易做的事」。

text: Her social life filled up after the new job began.
translation: 新工作开始后她的社交生活充实起来了。
note: social 此处是形容词「社交的、交际的」。

text: The club offers social events every weekend for members.
translation: 俱乐部为会员每周举办社交活动。
note: social 此处意为「社交的」。

text: He was known for his pleasant social manner at parties.
translation: 他因在聚会中令人愉快的社交举止而闻名。
note: social 此处形容「社交的、交际的」。

text: A social weekend helps her meet new people in town.
translation: 一个社交周末帮她结识了镇上的新朋友。
note: social 此处是形容词「社交的」。

text: The event was a chance to improve social ties with clients.
translation: 这次活动是改善与客户社交关系的机会。
note: social 此处意为「社交的、交涉的」。

text: Every mother wants her son to grow up healthy.
translation: 每位母亲都希望孩子健康成长。
note: son 此处是名词，指「孩子、子女」，不限性别。

text: Their son studies medicine in another large city.
translation: 他们的孩子在另一座大城市学医。
note: son 此处意为「子女、孩子」。

text: A farmer's son works the land from early dawn.
translation: 农民的孩子从黎明起就在田间劳作。
note: son 此处泛指「儿子/孩子」。

text: The villagers treat every son of the family kindly.
translation: 村民们善意地对待这家人的每一个孩子。
note: son 此处意为「孩子、后代」。

text: No son of the family speaks foreign languages well.
translation: 这家没有哪个孩子精通外语。
note: son 此处指「子女」，可指男孩或女孩。

text: In spring the cherry trees along the river turn pink.
translation: 春天河边的樱花变成粉色。
note: spring 此处是名词「春天、春季」。

text: Farmers wait for spring to plant the rice seedlings.
translation: 农民等待春天来插秧。
note: spring 意为「春天」。

text: The park looks different in spring after the long winter.
translation: 漫长冬季过后，公园在春天看起来不一样。
note: spring 此处是名词，指春季。

text: Many birds return to this lake every spring.
translation: 许多鸟儿每年春天回到这个湖边。
note: spring 意为「春天」。

text: Spring weather here is warm and full of sunshine.
translation: 这里的春天天气温暖，阳光充足。
note: spring 此处作名词，指春季。

text: The old warehouse serves as storage for winter equipment.
translation: 这座旧仓库用作冬季设备的库房。
note: storage 此处是名词「库房、储存处」。

text: They built a small storage behind the farm house.
translation: 他们在农舍后面建了一间小库房。
note: storage 此处指「储藏室、库房」。

text: Grain is kept in the storage until market prices rise.
translation: 粮食储存在库房里，直到市场价格上涨。
note: storage 此处是名词「储存处、仓房」。

text: The fishing gear is kept in a dry storage near the dock.
translation: 渔具存放在码头附近一间干燥的库房里。
note: storage 此处指「库房」。

text: Cold storage helps keep the fruit fresh for months.
translation: 冷藏库有助于让水果保鲜数月。
note: storage 此处是名词「储藏、库房」。

text: She strove for years to keep her family together.
translation: 她奋斗多年以维系家庭完整。
note: strive 此处意为「斗争、奋斗」，近 struggle。

text: The young soldiers strove against the bitter cold.
translation: 年轻的士兵们与刺骨的寒冷搏斗。
note: strive 意为「挣扎、奋斗」。

text: He strove against the current for half an hour.
translation: 他与水流搏斗了半个小时。
note: strive 此处意为「与……搏斗」。

text: Our team strove hard for the championship title.
translation: 我们队为冠军头衔奋力拼搏。
note: strive 意为「奋斗、拼搏」。

text: The plant strove to survive in the dry soil.
translation: 这株植物在干燥的土壤中挣扎着生存。
note: strive 此处意为「挣扎、奋斗」。

text: This soup has a strong taste of garlic and ginger.
translation: 这汤有很浓的大蒜和姜的味道。
note: taste 此处是名词「味道、口味」。

text: The new restaurant has a taste I cannot quite describe.
translation: 这家新餐厅有一种我说不清的味道。
note: taste 此处是名词，意为「味道」。

text: Add a little salt to improve the taste of the soup.
translation: 加一点盐来改善汤的味道。
note: taste 此处作名词「味道、味觉」。

text: The ice cream has a light taste of lemon and mint.
translation: 这份冰淇淋有淡淡的柠檬和薄荷味。
note: taste 此处是名词「味道、口味」。

text: His illness has left him with almost no sense of taste.
translation: 他的病让他几乎失去了味觉。
note: taste 此处是名词「味道、味觉」。

text: The bank closed the business early on holidays.
translation: 银行假日很早就停止营业。
note: transaction 此处指「业务、营业」，与单笔交易不同。

text: Daily business at the shop slows down in January.
translation: 这家店的日常营业在一月份会变慢。
note: transaction 意为「业务、经营活动」。

text: New business will open in the building next spring.
translation: 明年春天新业务将在这栋楼里开办。
note: transaction 此处指「业务、营业」。

text: He runs a small business repairing old typewriters.
translation: 他经营着一家修理旧打字机的小生意。
note: transaction 意为「业务、经营」。

text: Business was booming before the war finally ended.
translation: 战争最终结束前， business 一直很兴旺。
note: transaction 此处指「业务、生意」。

text: A brave boy climbed the tall tree in their garden.
translation: 一个勇敢的男孩爬上了他们花园里那棵高树。
note: tree 此处是动词「爬上（树）」。

text: Monkeys often tree themselves to escape the hunters below.
translation: 猴子常爬到树上躲避下方的猎人。
note: tree 作为动词意为「爬树」。

text: The cat treed the squirrel and waited patiently below.
translation: 这只猫把松鼠逼上树，然后在下面耐心等待。
note: tree 此处是动词「把……逼上树」。

text: The leopard treed the antelope and pulled it down slowly.
translation: 豹把羚羊逼上树后慢慢拉了下来。
note: tree 此处为动词「使……上树、逼上树」。

text: Birds tree themselves high in the oak every evening.
translation: 鸟儿每天傍晚都爬到高高的橡树上。
note: tree 此处作动词「爬到树上」。

text: Careful planning underlies every successful project of ours.
translation: 细致的计划是我们每个成功项目的基础。
note: underlie 此处是动词「构成……的基础、支撑」。

text: A strong trust underlies their long business partnership.
translation: 深厚的信任支撑着他们长期的商业伙伴关系。
note: underlie 意为「构成……的基础」。

text: Hidden fear underlies many of his seemingly calm decisions.
translation: 隐藏的恐惧是他许多看似冷静决策的基础。
note: underlie 此处指「构成……的基础」。

text: Basic assumptions underlie the whole theory of the book.
translation: 基本假设构成了这本书整个理论的基础。
note: underlie 此处是「支撑、构成基础」。

text: A shared value underlies all the rules in this school.
translation: 一个共同的价值观构成了这所学校所有规则的基础。
note: underlie 此处意为「构成……的基础」。

text: We use a bicycle to save money on transport daily.
translation: 我们用自行车，每天都能省下交通费。
note: use 此处是及物动词「使用、利用」。

text: The kitchen uses a large wooden table for meals.
translation: 厨房用一张大木桌吃饭。
note: use 意为「使用（工具、物品）」。

text: He used his old car to drive to work daily.
translation: 他每天开自己的旧车上班。
note: use 此处是 vt.「用、使用」。

text: Please use the stairs while the lift is being fixed.
translation: 电梯维修期间请走楼梯。
note: use 意为「使用、利用」。

text: Farmers here use a simple wooden plough instead.
translation: 这里的农民用一种简单的木犁代替。
note: use 此处是及物动词「使用」。

text: The soup is very hot, so please eat it slowly.
translation: 汤非常烫，请慢慢喝。
note: very 此处是副词「非常」，修饰形容词。

text: She has very little time left before the exam starts.
translation: 考试开始前她剩下的时间非常少。
note: very 意为「非常、极」。

text: The library has very many books on modern economics.
translation: 图书馆有非常多的现代经济学书籍。
note: very 此处是副词「非常」。

text: It was very late when they finally finished the work.
translation: 他们终于完成工作时天色已非常晚。
note: very 意为「非常」。

text: The road was very difficult to walk along the cliff.
translation: 沿着悬崖的那条路非常难走。
note: very 此处是副词，修饰形容词。

text: Religious frenzy and violence spread through the old town.
translation: 宗教狂热与狂躁蔓延到这座老镇。
note: violence 此处是名词「狂热、激烈情绪」。

text: The crowd burst into violence after the cruel verdict.
translation: 那个残酷判决后，人群爆发出一阵狂热。
note: violence 意为「狂热、激愤」。

text: Her voice was full of violence and barely controlled.
translation: 她的声音充满狂热，几乎无法控制。
note: violence 此处指「激烈的情感」。

text: He answered my question with obvious violence and anger.
translation: 他带着明显的激愤和怒气回答我的问题。
note: violence 意为「狂热、激烈的情绪」。

text: The fans showed such violence for their new champion.
translation: 球迷们对新冠军表现出如此狂热。
note: violence 此处是名词「狂热」。

text: The office is closed all weekend without exception.
translation: 办公室周末一律休息，无例外。
note: week 此处与 end 构成 weekend，意为「周末」。

text: We spent the weekend quietly reading at home together.
translation: 我们一起在家安静地度过了周末。
note: week 此处指周末（weekend 的一部分）。

text: She works every weekend at the busy weekend market.
translation: 她每个周末都在繁忙的周末市场工作。
note: week 此处意为「周末」。

text: The library stays open throughout the whole weekend.
translation: 图书馆整个周末都保持开放。
note: week 此处指「周末」。

text: He plays tennis with his brother each weekend afternoon.
translation: 他每个周末下午都和弟弟打网球。
note: week 此处是「周末」。

text: She sings well enough to win the school prize.
translation: 她唱得足够好，足以赢得学校奖项。
note: well 此处是副词「好地」，修饰动词。

text: He did well on the final exam this past term.
translation: 他上学期期末考试考得很好。
note: well 此处是副词「好、不错」。

text: The two brothers cook well and never burn the food.
translation: 这两兄弟做饭很好，从不烧焦食物。
note: well 此处是副词「好地」。

text: Speak clearly and well so everyone can hear you.
translation: 说得清楚又好，让每个人都能听见你。
note: well 此处是副词「好地」。

text: If you sleep well, you will work well tomorrow too.
translation: 如果你睡得好，明天也会工作得好。
note: well 此处是副词，修饰动词。

text: Where did you first hear about this interesting book?
translation: 你第一次听说这本有趣的书是在哪里？
note: where 此处是疑问副词「在哪里」。

text: Where are we supposed to meet for the morning class?
translation: 我们该在哪里碰面上上午的课？
note: where 意为「在哪里」。

text: Where did you spend your childhood in the mountain town?
translation: 你的童年是在哪个山间小镇度过的？
note: where 此处意为「在哪里」。

text: Where can I find a quiet place to study tonight?
translation: 今晚我在哪里可以找到一个安静的学习地方？
note: where 此处是「在哪里」。

text: Where were you when the lights suddenly went out?
translation: 突然停电的时候你在哪里？
note: where 意为「在哪里」。

text: His leg was wounded in the mountain climbing accident.
translation: 他的腿在登山事故中受伤了。
note: wound 此处是形容词「受伤的」。

text: The wounded soldiers were taken to the field hospital.
translation: 伤兵们被送往野战医院。
note: wound 此处是形容词「受伤的」。

text: She felt wounded by his cruel remarks at the party.
translation: 他在聚会上的残忍话语让她感到受伤。
note: wound 此处意为「受伤的（感情上）」。

text: He had a wounded look in his eyes all that week.
translation: 那一周他眼神一直带着受伤的神色。
note: wound 此处是形容词「受伤的」。

text: The wounded deer struggled slowly up the forest path.
translation: 受伤的鹿艰难地慢慢走上林间小路。
note: wound 此处修饰名词，指「受伤的」。
